parameters.query:
-- Claim leads that are ready for a first message, and open their run in the
-- same statement so the agent_runs row is the claim.
--
-- The recipient must have a usable address and must not be suppressed. Both
-- are checked again downstream - suppression by the trigger on outreach - but
-- checking here is what stops a draft being written for somebody unreachable
-- and costing a model call to find out.
WITH claimed AS (
    SELECT l.id,
           CASE WHEN l.status = 'new' THEN 1 ELSE s.last_step + 1 END AS sequence_step
    FROM leads l
    JOIN people p    ON p.id = l.person_id
    JOIN companies c ON c.id = l.company_id
    -- What has been sent to this lead so far. Nothing, for a first message.
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT max(o.sequence_step) AS last_step, max(o.sent_at) AS last_sent
        FROM outreach o
        WHERE o.lead_id = l.id AND o.status = 'sent'
    ) s ON true
    WHERE (
        -- A first message.
        (l.status = 'new'
         -- The company's ICP segment sets the bar (0024_icp_segments.sql);
         -- OUTREACH_MIN_SCORE for a company in no active segment.
         AND l.score >= outreach_min_score(c.segment, ($1::jsonb ->> 'min_score')::int)
         AND NOT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM outreach o WHERE o.lead_id = l.id AND o.sequence_step = 1
         )
         -- One first message per brand (0027_draft_quality.sql): shopbrand.example
         -- and ba.shopbrand.example are one company and both got a draft on
         -- 2026-10-02. A sibling's live message, or a sibling ahead of this one
         -- in the same claim, takes the brand; a rejected one does not.
         AND NOT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1
             FROM companies c2
             JOIN leads l2 ON l2.company_id = c2.id
             WHERE c2.id <> c.id
               AND domain_brand(c2.domain::text) = domain_brand(c.domain::text)
               AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outreach o2
                            WHERE o2.lead_id = l2.id
                              AND o2.status IN ('draft', 'pending_approval', 'approved', 'queued', 'sent'))
                    OR (l2.status = 'new'
                        AND l2.score >= outreach_min_score(c2.segment, ($1::jsonb ->> 'min_score')::int)
                        AND (l2.score, c2.id) > (l.score, c.id)))
         ))
        OR
        -- A follow-up: the last message went out OUTREACH_FOLLOWUP_DELAY_DAYS
        -- ago, fewer than OUTREACH_FOLLOWUP_MAX follow-ups have been written,
        -- and nobody has answered. Any reply moves the lead out of 'contacted'
        -- (WF-08); an inbound message on any of its threads is checked as
        -- well, because a reply the classifier has not reached yet is still a
        -- reply. A follow-up that was blocked, rejected or declined occupies
        -- its step, so nothing is written twice.
        (l.status = 'contacted'
         AND s.last_step IS NOT NULL
         AND s.last_step < 1 + ($1::jsonb ->> 'followup_max')::int
         AND s.last_sent < now() - make_interval(days => ($1::jsonb ->> 'followup_delay_days')::int)
         AND NOT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM outreach o WHERE o.lead_id = l.id AND o.sequence_step = s.last_step + 1
         )
         AND NOT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM conversations cv JOIN messages m ON m.conversation_id = cv.id
             WHERE cv.lead_id = l.id AND m.direction = 'inbound'
         ))
    )
      -- A draft needs somewhere to go. is_suppressed(NULL) is false and the
      -- trigger on outreach has nothing to compare against, so a lead whose
      -- recipient has no address reaches pending_approval addressed to nobody:
      -- measured on a large fintech, where WF-03 derived an address for the chief
      -- executive, WF-04 created the lead on it, and the address was withdrawn
      -- an hour later because his surname is "van der Berg".
      --
      -- WF-04 checks this when it creates the lead. It has to be checked again
      -- here because an address can be withdrawn or bounce between the two, and
      -- the same three statuses are what people_contactable_idx already calls
      -- contactable.
      AND p.email IS NOT NULL
      AND p.email_status IN ('valid', 'catch_all', 'guessed')
      AND NOT is_suppressed(p.email)
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM agent_runs r
          WHERE r.agent_name = 'outreach'
            AND r.status     = 'running'
            AND (r.input ->> 'lead_id')::uuid = l.id
            AND r.started_at > now() - interval '15 minutes'
      )
      -- A deploy is waiting to restart n8n: claim nothing (0021_deploy_drain.sql).
      AND NOT deploy_draining()
      -- Regional first messages are written at night by the large model, other
      -- first messages by day (Outreach Window). A country is regional when
      -- OUTREACH_LANGUAGES gives it a language prompts/outreach.md has a block
      -- for. Every follow-up is written at night: the 9B model's follow-ups
      -- repeated the first message word for word, the 27B's added a new
      -- sourced fact (2026-09-24).
      AND CASE WHEN l.status = 'contacted' THEN $1::jsonb ->> 'window' = 'night'
               -- A segment email (0024) is written at night too, whatever the
               -- language: on 2026-09-29 the 27B declined a company whose map
               -- category was wrong ("segment mismatch"), the 9B wrote to a
               -- tableware shop about agency reporting.
               ELSE (upper(btrim(COALESCE(c.country, ''))) IN (
                        SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb -> 'regional_countries'))
                     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM icp_segments s
                                WHERE s.code = c.segment AND s.active AND s.angle IS NOT NULL)
                    ) = ($1::jsonb ->> 'window' = 'night')
          END
      -- One night batch at a time: the next hour's run does not claim over it
      -- (0023_night_drafting.sql).
      AND NOT ($1::jsonb ->> 'window' = 'night' AND night_drafting())
    -- Follow-ups first: they are due on a date, a first message is not.
    ORDER BY (l.status = 'contacted') DESC, l.score DESC, l.created_at
    LIMIT ($1::jsonb ->> 'batch_size')::int
    FOR UPDATE OF l SKIP LOCKED
),
opened AS (
    INSERT INTO agent_runs (agent_name, company_id, input, status, model, started_at)
    SELECT 'outreach', l.company_id,
           ($1::jsonb -> 'input') || jsonb_build_object('lead_id', l.id, 'sequence_step', claimed.sequence_step),
           'running', $1::jsonb ->> 'model', now()
    FROM claimed JOIN leads l ON l.id = claimed.id
    RETURNING id AS agent_run_id, (input ->> 'lead_id')::uuid AS lead_id,
              (input ->> 'sequence_step')::int AS sequence_step
)
SELECT o.agent_run_id,
       l.id AS lead_id,
       o.sequence_step,
       -- What was already sent, oldest first: the brief for a follow-up, and
       -- the first subject its "Re:" repeats.
       COALESCE((
           SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('step', x.sequence_step, 'subject', x.subject,
                                             'body', x.body, 'sent_at', x.sent_at)
                  ORDER BY x.sequence_step)
           FROM outreach x WHERE x.lead_id = l.id AND x.status = 'sent'
       ), '[]'::json) AS previous,
       l.score,
       l.reason AS lead_reason,
       l.recommended_offer,
       c.id AS company_id,
       c.name AS company_name,
       c.domain::text AS domain,
       c.industry,
       c.country,
       c.employee_count,
       c.description,
       c.segment,
       (SELECT s.angle FROM icp_segments s WHERE s.code = c.segment AND s.active) AS segment_angle,
       -- What may be said about the country's invoicing (0027_draft_quality.sql).
       (SELECT cf.e_invoicing FROM country_facts cf WHERE cf.country = upper(btrim(c.country))) AS country_e_invoicing,
       -- The campaign this message is counted under (0026_first_revenue.sql): a
       -- follow-up keeps its first message's, a first message takes the
       -- segment's running one, and NULL when the segment has none.
       campaign_for_lead(l.id) AS campaign,
       -- A role contact (0022_role_contacts.sql) has no name, and none is made
       -- up for it here: both stay NULL and Validate And Check greets it with
       -- the general greeting from prompts/signature.md.
       p.kind       AS person_kind,
       -- A role contact at a firm whose own site names its owner or director:
       -- the mail still goes to the general address, marked for that person
       -- ("N/r:"), so whoever reads the inbox knows who it is for. Only a
       -- name the site printed with a decision-maker title; a staff list
       -- with no roles names nobody here.
       CASE WHEN p.kind = 'role' THEN (
           SELECT json_build_object('name', a.full_name, 'title', a.title, 'source', a.source_url)
           FROM people a
           WHERE a.company_id = c.id
             AND a.kind = 'person'
             AND btrim(COALESCE(a.full_name, '')) ~ '\S+\s+\S+'
             AND a.title ~* '(direktor|vlasni|osniva|uprav|prokurist|zastup|odgovorna osoba|lastni|poslovodj|owner|founder|ceo|managing director|директор|управител|сопственик|основач)'
           ORDER BY (a.title ~* '(vlasni|osniva|owner|founder|lastni|сопственик|основач)') DESC,
                    a.created_at
           LIMIT 1) END AS attention,
       p.full_name  AS person_name,
       CASE WHEN p.kind = 'role' THEN NULL
            -- An honorific is not a first name: on 2026-09-24 a first message
            -- went out as "Hi Dr.," to Dr. Lisa Graham. Titles are stripped
            -- before the first word is taken.
            ELSE split_part(regexp_replace(btrim(p.full_name),
                     '^((dr|mr|mrs|ms|miss|prof|ing|mag|dipl|mgr|sir|dame)\.?\s+)+', '', 'i'),
                 ' ', 1) END AS person_first_name,
       p.title      AS person_title,
       p.email::text AS person_email,
       COALESCE((
           SELECT r.output -> 'analysis'
           FROM agent_runs r
           WHERE r.company_id = c.id AND r.agent_name = 'research' AND r.status = 'success'
           ORDER BY r.finished_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
       ), '{}'::jsonb) AS research_analysis,
       COALESCE((
           SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
                      'signal_type', s.signal_type, 'signal', s.signal,
                      'source_url', s.source_url, 'confidence', s.confidence)
                  ORDER BY s.created_at)
           FROM signals s WHERE s.company_id = c.id
       ), '[]'::json) AS signals,
       -- Every URL the research actually found, from both places it lands.
       -- hook_source must be one of these or the human approving the draft
       -- cannot check the one claim the message rests on.
       COALESCE((
           SELECT json_agg(DISTINCT src)
           FROM (
               SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(
                          COALESCE(r.output #> '{analysis,sources}', '[]'::jsonb)) AS src
               FROM agent_runs r
               WHERE r.company_id = c.id AND r.agent_name = 'research' AND r.status = 'success'
               UNION
               SELECT s.source_url FROM signals s
               WHERE s.company_id = c.id AND s.source_url IS NOT NULL
           ) u
           WHERE src IS NOT NULL AND src <> ''
       ), '[]'::json) AS known_sources
FROM opened o
JOIN leads l     ON l.id = o.lead_id
JOIN people p    ON p.id = l.person_id
JOIN companies c ON c.id = l.company_id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ batch_size: $json.batch_size, min_score: Number($env.OUTREACH_MIN_SCORE) || 60, followup_max: Number($env.OUTREACH_FOLLOWUP_MAX ?? 2), followup_delay_days: Number($env.OUTREACH_FOLLOWUP_DELAY_DAYS || 4), model: $json.model, window: $json.window, regional_countries: $json.regional_countries, input: { execution_id: String($execution.id), workflow_id: $workflow.id, stage: 'outreach', window: $json.window } } ) }}

nodes.name: Claim Leads
nodes.notes: First messages (leads at 'new' above OUTREACH_MIN_SCORE) and due follow-ups (leads at 'contacted', no reply).

nodes.name: Build Outreach Request
nodes.notes: The worked example in prompts/outreach.md is deliberately left out of the prompt: a local model copies it.

nodes.name: Validate And Check
nodes.notes: Word ceiling, banned phrases, calendar links, emoji, one question, and a hook_source that must be a URL the research actually found.

parameters.query:
-- The draft passed every check. It goes to pending_approval. From there a
-- human approves it on Telegram, or - only while the operator has autosend on
-- (0030_autosend.sql) - Autosend Check approves a first message that
-- autosend_blockers() finds nothing wrong with.
WITH payload AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p),
ins AS (
    INSERT INTO outreach (lead_id, channel, sequence_step, subject, body, status, segment, variant, campaign)
    SELECT (payload.p ->> 'lead_id')::uuid, 'email', COALESCE((payload.p ->> 'sequence_step')::smallint, 1),
           payload.p #>> '{draft,subject}',
           payload.p #>> '{draft,body}',
           'pending_approval',
           payload.p #>> '{experiment,segment}',
           COALESCE(payload.p -> 'experiment', '{}'::jsonb),
           -- Only a campaign that exists: a stale name from a run that started
           -- before the campaign was renamed is recorded as none, not a failure.
           (SELECT k.code FROM campaigns k WHERE k.code = payload.p #>> '{experiment,campaign}')
    FROM payload
    ON CONFLICT (lead_id, sequence_step) DO UPDATE
        SET subject = EXCLUDED.subject,
            body    = EXCLUDED.body,
            segment = EXCLUDED.segment,
            variant = EXCLUDED.variant,
            campaign = EXCLUDED.campaign,
            status  = 'pending_approval',
            rejection_reason = NULL
    RETURNING id, status
),
lead AS (
    UPDATE leads
    SET status = 'pending_approval'
    FROM payload
    WHERE leads.id = (payload.p ->> 'lead_id')::uuid
      AND leads.status = 'new'
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM ins)              AS outreach_id,
       (SELECT status FROM ins)          AS outreach_status,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM lead)::int  AS leads_moved,
       $1::jsonb ->> 'agent_run_id'      AS agent_run_id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ lead_id: $json.lead_id, agent_run_id: $json.agent_run_id, sequence_step: $json.sequence_step, draft: $json.draft, experiment: $json.experiment } ) }}

nodes.name: Queue For Approval
nodes.notes: Stops at pending_approval. Autosend Check, next, is the only thing that may approve without a human.

parameters.query:
-- Two non-sending outcomes in one statement, told apart by 'outcome'.
--
-- 'blocked': a check failed. The draft is stored at 'draft' with the reason so a
-- human can read what the model actually wrote. It is never edited to comply -
-- docs/workflows.md: it is never auto-corrected.
--
-- 'not_sending': the agent judged there was nothing worth writing. No draft
-- exists to store. The lead moves to 'nurture' so it leaves the queue instead of
-- being re-generated every hour - from 'new' for a first message, from
-- 'contacted' when a follow-up had nothing new to say.
WITH payload AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS p),
ins AS (
    INSERT INTO outreach (lead_id, channel, sequence_step, subject, body, status, rejection_reason)
    SELECT (payload.p ->> 'lead_id')::uuid, 'email', COALESCE((payload.p ->> 'sequence_step')::smallint, 1),
           payload.p #>> '{draft,subject}',
           payload.p #>> '{draft,body}',
           'draft',
           payload.p ->> 'block_reason'
    FROM payload
    WHERE payload.p ->> 'outcome' = 'blocked'
    ON CONFLICT (lead_id, sequence_step) DO UPDATE
        SET subject          = EXCLUDED.subject,
            body             = EXCLUDED.body,
            status           = 'draft',
            rejection_reason = EXCLUDED.rejection_reason
    RETURNING id
),
nurtured AS (
    UPDATE leads
    SET status = 'nurture'
    FROM payload
    WHERE leads.id = (payload.p ->> 'lead_id')::uuid
      AND payload.p ->> 'outcome' = 'not_sending'
      AND leads.status IN ('new', 'contacted')
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ins)::int      AS drafts_blocked,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM nurtured)::int AS leads_nurtured,
       $1::jsonb ->> 'outcome'              AS outcome,
       $1::jsonb ->> 'agent_run_id'         AS agent_run_id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ lead_id: $json.lead_id, agent_run_id: $json.agent_run_id, sequence_step: $json.sequence_step, outcome: $json.outcome, draft: $json.draft, block_reason: $json.block_reason } ) }}

nodes.name: Store Blocked Or Skipped
nodes.notes: A blocked draft is kept verbatim for a human to read. It is never edited to comply.

parameters.query:
UPDATE agent_runs
SET status        = 'success',
    output        = $1::jsonb -> 'output',
    error         = NULL,
    prompt_tokens = ($1::jsonb #>> '{usage,prompt_tokens}')::int,
    output_tokens = ($1::jsonb #>> '{usage,completion_tokens}')::int,
    finished_at   = now()
WHERE id = ($1::jsonb ->> 'agent_run_id')::uuid
RETURNING id, company_id, status, duration_ms;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ agent_run_id: $('Validate And Check').item.json.agent_run_id, usage: $('Validate And Check').item.json.usage, output: { outcome: $('Validate And Check').item.json.outcome, attempt: $('Validate And Check').item.json.attempt, blocks: $('Validate And Check').item.json.blocks, notes: $('Validate And Check').item.json.notes, draft: $('Validate And Check').item.json.draft, model_output: $('Validate And Check').item.json.model_output } } ) }}

parameters.query:
-- The model failed or returned something unusable. No draft was written and the
-- lead stays at 'new', so the next hourly pass tries again.
UPDATE agent_runs
SET status      = 'error',
    error       = COALESCE(NULLIF($1::jsonb ->> 'error', ''), 'Outreach failed with no message'),
    output      = $1::jsonb -> 'output',
    finished_at = now()
WHERE id = ($1::jsonb ->> 'agent_run_id')::uuid
RETURNING id, company_id, status, error;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ agent_run_id: $json.agent_run_id, error: $json.error_message, output: { errors: $json.errors, attempt: $json.attempt, raw_response: $json.raw_response } } ) }}

parameters.query:
-- Guarded autosend (0030_autosend.sql).
--
-- autosend_decide() approves the draft only when OUTREACH_AUTOSEND_ENABLED is
-- exactly "true" (the master switch, .env), app_settings 'autosend' is on
-- (/autosend on, /stop on Telegram) and autosend_blockers() returns nothing:
-- a first message, Latin script, no known bad phrase, a person's name in the
-- greeting, a recipient never bounced or suppressed, nobody at the company in
-- a conversation, an active segment, the country's language, no sentence
-- another company already got. It then reads approved_by = 'autosend', and
-- WF-06 sends it like any approved row, inside the daily and per-domain
-- limits and working hours, and never while OUTREACH_PAUSED is not "false".
--
-- Only drafts that were NOT approved come out of this node, with the reasons
-- they were held, so Queue Draft Alert sends the operator the usual approval message
-- for those and nothing for the ones that went out by themselves. The daily
-- report lists those. With autosend off every draft comes out, as before.
--
-- The hook travels through here so Queue Draft Alert does not have to reach
-- back to Validate And Check across two nodes.
SELECT d.draft_id                  AS outreach_id,
       d.autosend_active,
       d.auto_approved,
       d.blockers,
       $1::jsonb ->> 'hook_fact'   AS hook_fact,
       $1::jsonb ->> 'hook_source' AS hook_source
FROM autosend_decide(($1::jsonb ->> 'outreach_id')::uuid,
                     ($1::jsonb ->> 'env_enabled')::boolean,
                     $1::jsonb ->> 'languages',
                     'wf05') d
WHERE NOT d.auto_approved;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ outreach_id: $json.outreach_id, env_enabled: String($env.OUTREACH_AUTOSEND_ENABLED ?? 'false').trim() === 'true', languages: String($env.OUTREACH_LANGUAGES ?? ''), hook_fact: $('Validate And Check').item.json.draft.hook_fact, hook_source: $('Validate And Check').item.json.draft.hook_source } ) }}

nodes.name: Autosend Check
nodes.notes: Approves a clean first message only while the operator has autosend on. Passes on only what still needs them.

parameters.query:
-- Queue the approval message described in docs/telegram.md.
--
-- The layout is not arbitrary and the comments in that document explain each
-- rule: the hook and its source come BEFORE the body, because the one thing
-- worth checking is whether the claim is true and that takes five seconds if
-- the link is at the top; and the whole body is shown, because an approval on
-- a summary is not an approval.
--
-- Everything except the hook is read from v_approval_queue, so the message
-- describes the row that was actually written, not what the workflow believes
-- it wrote. The hook comes in as a parameter because it lives in the agent's
-- output rather than in the outreach row.
--
-- Zero rows out means the draft was not found at pending_approval and nothing
-- is queued. That is a refused write, not a silent success.
--
-- It runs after Autosend Check, which passes on only the drafts autosend did
-- not approve; an approved one is not at pending_approval anyway, so it could
-- not be announced as waiting even if it arrived here.
WITH q AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM v_approval_queue
    WHERE outreach_id = ($1::jsonb ->> 'outreach_id')::uuid
),
composed AS (
    SELECT q.outreach_id,
           q.lead_id,
           q.company_id,
           CASE WHEN q.sequence_step > 1 THEN 'Follow-up ' || (q.sequence_step - 1) || ' ready: '
                ELSE 'Draft ready: ' END || q.company_name || ' — ' || COALESCE(q.full_name, 'general address') AS title,
           '[' || q.score_band || ' ' || COALESCE(q.score::text, '?') || ']  '
               || q.company_name || '  (' || q.domain || ')'
           || E'\n' || q.full_name || COALESCE(', ' || q.title, '')
           || E'\n' || 'Offer: ' || COALESCE(q.recommended_offer, 'none')
               || COALESCE('  ·  campaign ' || (SELECT o.campaign FROM outreach o WHERE o.id = q.outreach_id), '')
           -- The four questions a total hides (v_company_scores, 0026): is the
           -- company a fit, is there an opportunity, how sure is the process
           -- evidence, and is this the right person.
           || COALESCE(E'\n' || (SELECT format('Fit %s · opportunity %s · process evidence %s (%s sourced, %s not) · buyer %s',
                                     COALESCE(s.icp_fit::text, '?'), COALESCE(s.opportunity::text, '?'),
                                     s.process_confidence, s.process_signals_sourced, s.process_signals_unsourced,
                                     s.buyer_confidence)
                                 FROM v_company_scores s WHERE s.company_id = q.company_id), '')
           || E'\n\n' || 'Hook: '   || COALESCE(NULLIF($1::jsonb ->> 'hook_fact',   ''), '(none recorded)')
           || E'\n'   || 'Source: ' || COALESCE(NULLIF($1::jsonb ->> 'hook_source', ''), '(none recorded)')
           || E'\n\n' || 'Subject: ' || COALESCE(q.subject, '(none)')
           || E'\n\n' || q.body
           -- docs/telegram.md specifies /approve and /reject here. They are not
           -- built yet, and printing a command that does nothing would be worse
           -- than printing none. WF-11 handles them now, so they are printed.
           || E'\n\n' || 'id ' || left(q.outreach_id::text, 4)
               || '  ·  /approve ' || left(q.outreach_id::text, 4)
               || '   /reject '    || left(q.outreach_id::text, 4)
           -- Autosend is on and held this one (0030_autosend.sql): why, in one
           -- line, so the reason is read with the draft.
           || COALESCE(E'\n' || 'Autosend held it: ' || NULLIF((
                  SELECT string_agg(x, '; ')
                  FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(
                      CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof($1::jsonb -> 'autosend_blockers') = 'array'
                           THEN $1::jsonb -> 'autosend_blockers' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) x), ''), '')
               AS body
    FROM q
)
SELECT n.notification_id, n.status, n.occurrences, n.deduplicated,
       composed.outreach_id, composed.lead_id
FROM composed
CROSS JOIN LATERAL queue_notification(
    'draft_ready',
    'draft_ready:' || composed.outreach_id,
    composed.title,
    composed.body,
    -- Batched: a draft is not an emergency, and docs/telegram.md puts it in the
    -- batched row of its notification table.
    'batched',
    jsonb_build_object('outreach_id', composed.outreach_id, 'lead_id', composed.lead_id),
    composed.company_id,
    composed.lead_id,
    interval '7 days'
) n;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({ outreach_id: $json.outreach_id, hook_fact: $json.hook_fact, hook_source: $json.hook_source, autosend_blockers: $json.autosend_active ? $json.blockers : null } ) }}

nodes.name: Queue Draft Alert
nodes.notes: Off Queue For Approval through Autosend Check. The scoring path must not depend on a notification succeeding.

nodes.name: Outreach Window
nodes.notes: Night: regional leads, the large model, one batch. Day: everyone else in English.

nodes.name: Retry Once?
nodes.notes: Invalid JSON on the first attempt: ask once more. Anything else, or a second failure, closes the run.

nodes.name: Outreach Agent Retry
nodes.notes: The same request as Outreach Agent, sent once more. Feeds Validate And Check again.
